briefingText: AURON “Nineteen fights. That is all this is. In the FFX fights, nothing moves until you act. Take your time. In the FFX-2 fights, the clock keeps running until you pick a command. Then it waits while you choose.” ENTER / ESC SKIP — 20 SECONDS, ONCE D NEVER SHOW THIS AGAIN
dossier: AURON · 1 OF 3 “Start with this one.” Click its picture to begin. The others wait on the board. prepText: AURON · 2 OF 3 “Your party is ready.” The tabs are for later. Start the battle. ESC SKIP THE GUIDE PARTY PREP VII · SEYMOUR AND ANIMA — MACALANIA TEMPLE — THE ANTECHAMBER T Tidus S.LV 18 Y Yuna S.LV 18 R Rikku S.LV 40 W Wakka S.LV 18 A Auron S.LV 18 L Lulu S.LV 18 K Kimahri S.LV 18 CHAPTER STATS SPHERE GRID EQUIPMENT ITEMS OVERDRIVE FFX · VII Seymour and Anima The Second Refusal Seymour offers the pilgrimage a second time, and this time he does not ask — he calls Anima up through the chamber floor to make the answer for him. What she does to a party is not what she does to the aeon summoned to stand in front of them, and the fight is built entirely out of that gap. the chamber floor opens chained, drawn up regardless unhurried, still unhurried OBJECTIVES Down both Guado Guardians Survive Anima's Pain Defeat Seymour and Anima TIP Steal from each Guardian once — it ends the 1,000 HP Auto-Potion counter and the Hi-Potion Seymour gets below 4,800 HP, and it costs nothing but a turn. lines: That is what it looks like.
Step away from Lord Seymour, Lady Summoner.
You will not put hands on him again.
He has to be sent. Please. Let me finish.
They just destroyed the only proof.
Yunie. We have to go. Right now.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: The whole place is ice. Even the stairs. Rude.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Kimahri
dboxTimeline.text: Kimahri hears water. Under floor.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Tromell gave us armor. On the way in.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: He was proud of us, ya? Real proud.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: That is the worst part of it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: We watched the sphere. All of it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Jyscal named his own murderer.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: And Yunie just... carried it. Alone.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Guardians. You are early.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: She is still in the Chamber. Shall we wait?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: You killed your father

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Yes. In the spring. It took some time.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: He meant to die apologising to Spira.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: I would not let him leave like that.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Don't you sound reasonable. Not about that.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Say nothing. Let him finish.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: She accepted me. It surprised her guardians.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: It did not surprise me

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: She came to be alone in a room with me.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Don't.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: A summoner, a staff, and no witnesses.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: I admire it. Truly.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Maester Seymour.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Lady Yuna. They have told you what they think

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Tell them they are wrong. I will wait.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: You came here to kill me.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Yes.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Thank you. That was the last honest thing.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Guard her. Move.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: An aeon. He is summoning an aeon.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: She has waited a long time for this.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: She's winding up! That wasn't a spell!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: She's open! Hit her now, it'll hurt her more!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: His bar — hey! It's all the way back!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: We only broke his weapon. Not him.
He went down on one knee. The hall was very quiet.
Then he fell, and he just stopped.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: ...That's it?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: That is what it looks like.
Yuna knelt beside him and began the sending.
Step away from Lord Seymour, Lady Summoner.
You will not put hands on him again.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: He has to be sent. Please. Let me finish.
He will be cared for. By his own people.
And this. This was never yours.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: They just destroyed the only proof.
Traitors, all of you. It will be announced.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: ...I didn't send him.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Kimahri
dboxTimeline.text: Then he does not rest.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Yunie. We have to go. Right now.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Down the ramp. Do not stop on the lake.
We won that fight in about six minutes.
Then they took the body, the sphere and our names.
I kept waiting for someone official to fix it.
That was the trick. There was nobody above him.
